objective: Resolve shorter sunflower Oil declarations using external identity evidence; apply already approved hair-weight tendency if matched.

SUNFLOWEROILCOSMILE20261004.title: COSMILE Europe: sunflower seed oil and shorter Helianthus annuus oil wording
SUNFLOWEROILCOSMILE20261004.access: Live ingredient page read 2026-10-04; plant-part field and opening background sentence.
SUNFLOWEROILCOSMILE20261004.supports: The background explicitly identifies Helianthus annuus oil as sunflower oil obtained from ripe seeds. Supports interpreting the shorter oil declaration as seed-derived fixed oil; skin penetration/lightness claims do not choose hair weight. No universal supplier-grade equivalence.

SUNFLOWEROILNLM20261004.title: NLM MeSH: Sunflower Oil
SUNFLOWEROILNLM20261004.supports: Defines sunflower oil as seed-derived and includes Sunflower Seed Oil among entry terms. Corroborates ordinary material terminology, not cosmetic grade, composition or hair weight.

SUNFLOWEROILK18UK20261004.title: K18 UK Molecular Repair Hair Oil: exact parenthetical Oil declaration
SUNFLOWEROILK18UK20261004.access: Live UK maker ingredient list read 2026-10-04.
SUNFLOWEROILK18UK20261004.supports: Exact Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Oil at rank four in the 17-entry UK declaration matches the frozen Q10/W01 ingredient sequence. Establishes encountered commercial spelling, not seed extraction method, supplier grade, concentration or neat-oil weight.

SUNFLOWERDERIVATIVELIMITCIR20261004.title: CIR 2016 sunflower-derived ingredients assessment: distinct extracts, waxes and oils
SUNFLOWERDERIVATIVELIMITCIR20261004.access: Live PDF introduction and definitions table read 2026-10-04.
SUNFLOWERDERIVATIVELIMITCIR20261004.supports: Treats extracts, waxes and powders separately from oils; seed oils were assessed in the plant-derived oil report. Supports retaining derivative/plant-part boundaries, not a hair-weight or efficacy claim.

external_identity_finding: The shorter Helianthus annuus oil name is seed-derived in registry background; exact parenthetical commercial spelling is confirmed by K18 UK.

internal_weight_application.basis: explicit material-family estimate from existing approved sunflower tendency
internal_weight_application.excluded: skin lightness and absorption; finished K18 marketing/performance

product_source_check.comparison: Exact case/whitespace-insensitive ordered list match; full UK sequence observed in live web tool, no plant-part normalization.
product_source_check.market_limit: UK corroboration of selected DE retailer declaration; physical DE pack/batch and supplier grade unverified. Global 22-entry alternative remains distinct.

limits: No general removal of Seed or parentheses. Only two reviewed shorter Oil spellings are admitted.
Not every supplier grade is characterized; high-oleic composition is not inferred.
Extracts, wax/butter, unsaponifiables and modified derivatives remain distinct.
Frozen outputs remain historical and no new formula classification run follows.
next_work: Prepare a broader contrast cohort containing heavier retained-film systems, lighter carriers and borderline blends with current exact references frozen.
